messages:
Ellen: Promo blocked, deploy-bot aborted canary — artifact upload failed with checksum error.
deploy-bot: Promotion aborted: job `canary-integrations` failed (exit=1). Logs: https://ci.redwood/1748888888 :warning:
Ellen: Quick grep shows `cache-metadata: version=4` while server expects v3 — looks like a proto/gen mismatch.
Raj: I can reproduce locally with `redwood/builder:edge-2026-03-21`. Works with `redwood/builder:stable-2026-02-28`.
Nia: Change window in ~1h. Options: pin the promo runner to stable image or rollback the proto bump now (will delay).
Raj: Pinning is lower blast radius. We'll need a follow-up to re-run full canary after the toolchain fix.
Nia: I'll open a small MR to pin `redwood/builder:stable-2026-02-28` in the promo job and retrigger. ETA 15m.
ops-bot: Incident CI_UPLOAD_1748888888 created. Please acknowledge within 30m to avoid escalation.
deploy-bot: Manual retrigger requested by Nia — job queued.
release: Add release note: "Promotion pinned to previous builder image due to artifact upload proto mismatch; verification pending." Tag `requires-followup`.
Raj: I'll run a reproducer matrix across builder vs cache-server versions to capture the exact proto diff.
deploy-bot: Canary rerun started, step `artifact-upload` in progress.
Ellen: Proceed with pin path for now. If rerun fails we reconvene and consider delaying the change window. :thumbsup:
